title: Integration test file is unformatted — will fail gleam format --check in CI
evidence:
$ gleam format --check server/test/integration/application_integration_test.gleam
error: These files have not been formatted
  - server/test/integration/application_integration_test.gleam

--- the line that format wants to join ---
  let assert Ok(entry) =
    list.find(response.entries, fn(e) { e.id == app_id })
+++ formatted ---
  let assert Ok(entry) = list.find(response.entries, fn(e) { e.id == app_id })
detail: CI format gate is repo-wide and fails on any unformatted file. The list_endpoint_renders_viewed_status_test added a let-assert line split that gleam format wants on one line.
recommended_fix: Run `gleam format server/test/integration/application_integration_test.gleam` and commit the result.
